trigger: The completed original paid stability trial exposed a false catalog declaration of a confirmed user version in unknown-version inputs. Original paid outputs and their failure classifications remain unchanged.
scope: Deterministic core catalog and full-rendered-surface truth controls only; no new model request, tracker/UI edit, retrieval index or evaluation corpus change.
hypothesis: An active user-reported installed release is required before declaring exact-version documentation absent from a nonempty evidence bundle. Empty evidence is a genuine source gap even when the version remains unknown, and must be described as empty evidence.

policy.unknown_version_with_supplied_records: Register the necessary user version question; do not declare exact-version documentary coverage missing before the version is known.
policy.unknown_version_with_empty_evidence: Register a user version question and a separately honest empty-documentation source gap.
policy.known_version_with_no_exact_metadata: Retain the source gap; historical or unversioned supplied records do not establish current-release coverage.
policy.known_version_with_exact_metadata: No version coverage gap; exact metadata still does not verify authenticity, cause or fix.
policy.confirmation: Only active USER facts; source/evidence facts and superseded user facts cannot establish the current installed release.

version139.excerpt: Synthetic complete documentation paragraph for release 1.39.0. It describes state retention, without establishing any application cause or fix.

version150.excerpt: Synthetic complete documentation paragraph for release 1.50.0. It describes state retention, without establishing any application cause or fix.

unversioned.excerpt: Synthetic complete unversioned documentation paragraph. Source applicability still requires the currently reported installed release.
